set.body: Use the unmodified CC-BY-ND4.0 Zenodo1156863 C023.asc. Verify exact bytes, reconcile every row, retain observed native events/messages/CR warnings, and run source-supported pixel IDT to Scanpath on JVM and Scala.js. Record unknown converter/EDF/viewing evidence honestly. This bounds the publication fixture path and does not certify the whole device matrix.
set.title: Qualify the complete public EDF-derived ASC through portable import and Scanpath
